x-arbitrary-json.scope: Successful HTTP response value inside remote returned data (SDK tolerance, not a native server receipt promise)
x-arbitrary-json.rationale: request parses serde_json::Value without receipt validation; wrapper copies the complete value and derives outer ok from a boolean field or true. Unknown response fields are preserved.
